title: Targeted recycling of glass-glass modules trades value for lower impact
summary: Targeted recycling of frameless, polyolefin elastomer-encapsulated glass-glass modules lowers energy use and global warming impact compared with treating the whole module, but reduces recovered material value, according to a new study, with silver dominating revenue. The post Targeted recycling of glass-glass modules trades value for lower impact appeared first on pv magazine Global .
